headline_item.title_zh: 1Password称黑客侵入其内部系统，但客户密码是安全的
headline_item.title_en: 1Password said hackers broke into its internal systems, but customer passwords are safe
headline_item.author: Zack Whittaker
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 密码管理器制造商 1Password 已确认，部分客户信息在最近对其内部系统的入侵中被盗取，但客户密码库和其他机密并未被访问。这家总部位于多伦多的科技公司在周三发表的一篇博客文章中表示，它在 11 月检测到了一次入侵
headline_item.event_summary_en:
Password manager maker 1Password has confirmed that some customer information was taken in a recent intrusion into its internal systems, but that customer password vaults and other secrets were not accessed.

The Toronto-based tech company said in a blog post published Wednesday that it detected an intrusion on November 19, in which an attacker gained access to an employee’s corporate account with GitHub, which the company uses to share and store its source code.

The attacker used that employee
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国证券交易委员会 (SEC)在全球大模型开源社区与技术研发一线：1Password称黑客侵入其内部系统，但客户密码是安全的
【核心事实细节】1Password称黑客侵入其内部系统，但客户密码是安全的。
【行业研判】这家总部位于多伦多的科技公司在周三发布的一篇博客文章中表示，它在 11 月 19 日检测到一次入侵，其中攻击者盖。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Zack Whittaker: 1Password said hackers broke into its internal systems, but customer passwords are safe

[Root Cause & Mechanism] Password manager maker 1Password has confirmed that some customer information was taken in a recent intrusion into its internal systems, but that customer password vaults and other secrets were not accessed.

[Key Technical Spec] The Toronto-based tech company said in a blog post published Wednesday that it detected an intrusion on November 19, in which an attacker gained access to an employee’s corporate account with GitHub, which the company uses to share and store its source code.
[Industry Analysis] The attacker used that employee.

headlines.author: Axios
headlines.event_summary_zh: Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 周三拒绝了人类应该向人工智能放弃自由意志的观点，反驳了 Axios 关于人工智能高管之间意识形态分歧日益扩大的报道。重要性：这是阿莫代自上周公司上市以来最重要的公开言论。他在说什么
headlines.event_summary_en:
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on Wednesday rejected the notion that humans should surrender free will to AI, pushing back on Axios' reporting about a growing ideological divide among top AI executives.

Why it matters: This is Amodei's most significant public remarks since the company went public last week.

What he's saying: "We should never sacrifice legitimacy or self-determination at the altar of efficiency or security," Amodei said.

The debate about control comes amid a rocky debut for Anthro
